title: Fortinet security vulnerability
leadParagraph: Fortinet has released a security update to address a critical vulnerability (CVE-2023-33308) affecting FortiOS and FortiProxy.
contentHtml:
Fortinet has released a security update to address a critical vulnerability (CVE-2023-33308) affecting FortiOS and FortiProxy.

TT-CSIRT encourages administrators to review the following release from Fortinet and take the necessary actions immediately: https://www.fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-23-183
